statements.headline: Hazardous Weather Outlook
statements.summary: Today and tonight. Showers and thunderstorms are expected again this afternoon.Some storms could be severe. Damaging wind is the primary threat, but large hail is also a possibility. Also, localized flooding is possible in areas that receive multiple thunderstorms.

details.label: Today's Hazards
details.text: Today and tonight. Showers and thunderstorms are expected again this afternoon.Some storms could be severe. Damaging wind is the primary threat, but large hail is also a possibility. Also, localized flooding is possible in areas that receive multiple thunderstorms.

details.label: Extended Outlook
details.text: Saturday through Thursday. No hazardous weather is expected at this time.
